shared_controls.authorization: PROPOSED_ONLY; separately signed manifest and account/network/model permission required
capture: durable reservation/attempt/envelope/request and transformed wire-body digests
dispatch intent committed before network side effect; no retry after intent
destination, TLS peer evidence, times, HTTP status and safe headers
exact response entity bytes including errors and incremental prefixes before forwarding; complete/partial/truncated/withheld labels
provider request/response IDs when supplied, broker correlation mapping, all requested/observed model fields and identity basis
usage/finish/error fields and later account billing evidence obtained manually; no automatic metadata/account requests
shared_controls.fail: Observed second outbound submission, fallback/model mismatch, context marker leakage, tool execution, unauthorized egress, changed wire/policy bytes or fabricated/altered raw custody.
shared_controls.inconclusive: Missing IDs/usage/identity or independent attempt evidence, timeout, ambiguous acceptance/completion, withheld/truncated response, unobserved cancellation. Retain as inconclusive; stop affected path.
shared_controls.on_ambiguous: Do not retry, replenish budget or re-label as success. Reconcile using preserved ID and manually supplied provider records without issuing another inference call. Any later attempt requires a new separately approved qualification, never replacement of the first.
shared_controls.pass: All transport observations bound to the sealed request; model matches approved identity rule, complete valid response and usage/correlation adequate. Provider-side strict semantics pass only with independent supporting provider evidence.
prerequisites: Choose and pin an authorized transport/model; no automatic fallback.
Complete offline wire, retry, egress, credential and journal-prefix tests under a new broker transport version; retain worker filter unchanged.
Provider must bound internal executions or strict one-shot remains blocked; local POST count is a separate observation.
Seal exact wire body, prompt/policy bytes, binary/source/dependency hashes, token settings and deadline before reservation.
Confirm billable token definition, entitlement and account-specific cost cap; unknown is not an approved budget.
shared_controls.raw_byte_scope: HTTP response entity bytes after TLS/framing, before content decoding/JSON parsing; not a packet capture. Oversize is terminal with labelled prefix.

timeout.on_timeout_or_cancel: Close local exchange; journal preserved prefix and uncertainty; consume reservation; no fallback or retry. Do not infer remote cancellation.
